title: SoundHub – New Music Release Campaign
description: A creative promotional campaign concept for SoundHub Music Channel, featuring an energetic new music release. The design combines premium gold and black visuals, DJ-inspired imagery, bold typography and music platform branding to create an engaging promotional poster.

title: DJ VibeZ – Brand New Song Launch
description: A vibrant music release promotional design created for the DJ VibeZ brand concept. Featuring purple and pink neon lighting, bold brush typography and modern music-inspired visuals, this artwork communicates an energetic new song launch.

title: GlowWithMe – Beauty & Lifestyle Campaign
description: A modern beauty and lifestyle promotional campaign concept for GlowWithMe. The design features a soft pink aesthetic with beauty tutorials, fashion inspiration, self-care routines, daily vlogs and travel content. Created to communicate a friendly and engaging lifestyle brand identity.

title: NextTech – Best Laptops Buying Guide
description: A bold technology content thumbnail concept designed for NextTech. The artwork highlights a laptop buying guide with a strong black and yellow visual identity, featuring performance testing, battery life, price comparisons and gaming versus productivity.

title: BurgerHub – Burger Food Advertisement
description: A premium food advertising concept created for BurgerHub. The design showcases a delicious burger, fries and combo meals using bold black and yellow branding. The composition highlights product quality, food appeal and a strong order-now call to action.

title: Nexora Motors – Drive Your Story Campaign
description: A complete automotive dealership campaign concept for Nexora Motors, designed as a five-panel promotional presentation. The campaign showcases vehicle categories, dealership benefits, featured cars, pricing presentation and customer contact information through a consistent red, black and white brand identity. Copy

title: NoaAK – Creative Graphic Design Studio
description: A premium promotional banner concept for NoaAK Creative Digital Agency. The design showcases social media graphics, branding materials, print designs and creative visual concepts. Featuring a bold black and gold aesthetic, the composition highlights creative services and professional design capabilities.

title: Naturéa – Lavender Glow Skincare Advertisement
description:
A luxury skincare advertising concept created for Naturéa Skincare. This design showcases a Lavender Glow moisturizing cream with a premium lavender and purple visual identity. Featuring elegant product presentation, botanical elements, soft lighting and sophisticated typography, the artwork communicates a natural beauty and skincare brand concept.
This is a speculative portfolio project. Product claims and brand details are illustrative.
 Copy

title: GlowBella – Natural Glow Beauty Cream
description:
A premium beauty cream advertising concept for GlowBella Skincare. Designed with an elegant pink and white colour palette, the artwork combines beauty-focused lifestyle imagery, attractive product presentation, floral elements and modern promotional typography. Created to represent a feminine and luxurious skincare brand identity.

This is a speculative portfolio project. Product details and claims are illustrative.

title: AquaPure – Natural Drinking Water Campaign
description:
A refreshing bottled water advertising concept created for AquaPure. The design features a premium water bottle, natural mountain scenery, flowing water and a clean blue visual identity. The composition highlights freshness, purity-inspired branding, product presentation and a strong promotional call to action.

This is a speculative portfolio project. Brand claims and contact details are illustrative.

title: TechZone – Latest Smartphone Promotional Campaign
description:
A premium smartphone retail advertising concept for TechZone. Featuring a bold black and yellow colour scheme, the design showcases a flagship smartphone with product specifications, promotional pricing, accessory bundle highlights and retail branding. Created to deliver a modern, attention-grabbing electronics advertising experience.

This is a speculative portfolio project. Product pricing, specifications, offers and contact details are illustrative and require verification before commercial use.

title: TasteVilla – Authentic Sri Lankan Food Advertisement
description:
A premium restaurant advertising concept for TasteVilla, inspired by authentic Sri Lankan cuisine. The artwork showcases a traditional rice and curry meal with rich food photography, natural ingredients, traditional serving elements and a bold black and golden visual identity. Designed to create appetite appeal and promote a restaurant dining experience.

This is a speculative portfolio project. Menu prices, location and contact details are illustrative.

title: ABANS – Corporate Business Card Design
description:
A premium corporate business card design concept for ABANS Company (Pvt) Ltd. The design combines a sophisticated black, white and gold colour palette with a clean layout, professional typography and an interior design visual. Created to represent a modern company specialising in doors, flooring, wall panels and building solutions.

This is an independent design concept and is not presented as officially commissioned ABANS artwork.

title: Nexora – Creative Studio Brand Identity
description:
A complete brand identity concept for Nexora Creative Studio. The project includes primary and alternative logo designs, brand icon, colour palette, typography and branded applications. The visual identity uses a bold black and yellow colour combination to communicate creativity, professionalism and modern design. The presentation showcases business cards, stationery, packaging, apparel, signage and digital branding applications.

This is a self-initiated brand identity concept.

title: Beanora – Coffee House Brand Identity
description:
A premium brand identity concept developed for Beanora Coffee House. The project features a distinctive coffee-inspired logo, alternative logo versions, brand icon, carefully selected colour palette and typography system. The identity is extended across coffee cups, coffee packaging, business cards and outdoor signage. The combination of deep plum, warm beige, olive green and cream creates a sophisticated and welcoming coffee house identity.

This is a self-initiated branding concept.

title: From Random Posting to Real Growth
description: A creative kinetic typography motion graphics video highlighting the importance of a proper social media content strategy. The video communicates how random posting without planning and direction leads to poor results, while consistent content, clear messaging, and a strong strategy create real growth. Designed with bold typography, smooth transitions, minimal visuals, and striking yellow, black, and white colour combinations.

title: Creativity Is Seeing Things Differently
description: A creative short-form motion graphics video exploring the power of creativity and different perspectives. This project combines animated typography, visual storytelling, 3D brain visuals, pop-culture meme elements, and motivational messages. Designed with smooth transitions, dynamic text animations, and clean visual compositions to create an engaging and memorable viewing experience.

title: Stop Comparing Your Beginning to Someone Else's Middle
description: A motivational animated typography video highlighting the negative effects of comparing your personal journey with others. Through creative illustrations, kinetic typography, smooth transitions, and engaging visual storytelling, the video explores how comparing your beginning to someone else's middle can damage your confidence. It delivers a powerful reminder that everyone has different starting points, struggles, and sacrifices. Created in a modern short-form vertical video format.

title: You Don't Need More Ads
description: A dynamic short-form business marketing video designed to highlight the importance of effective social media content and audience engagement. This project combines kinetic typography, animated text, smartphone mockups, social media profile visuals, audience statistics, and smooth motion transitions. Featuring a bold opening hook and clean blue-and-white visual styling, the video delivers a modern promotional message aimed at business owners and digital audiences.

title: your-imagination-is-the-real-power
description: A creative vertical motion graphics video exploring the power of imagination in video editing. The project features kinetic typography, animated software icons, smooth transitions, purple gradient effects, and engaging visual storytelling. It highlights popular editing tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and CapCut, delivering a powerful message that creativity is not limited by software but driven by imagination and ideas.

title: Aqualite Water Filter – Pure Water, Better Life
description: A professional AI-powered commercial advertisement created for Aqualite Water Filter. The video combines emotional family storytelling, cinematic AI-generated scenes, animated water purification visuals, and premium product showcases. It highlights the importance of clean drinking water while presenting the Aqualite water filtration system and its promotional benefits, including free delivery and installation, a one-year comprehensive warranty, and lifetime service support. Designed to create brand awareness, build customer trust, and encourage product inquiries.

title: Gem Zelonia – The Beauty of Sri Lankan Blue Sapphire
description: A premium cinematic advertisement created for Gem Zelonia, showcasing the elegance and beauty of Sri Lankan blue sapphire gemstones. The video combines stunning AI-generated cinematic visuals, Sri Lankan heritage-inspired landscapes, luxury jewellery close-ups, elegant model shots, and premium product packaging. Featuring sapphire rings and earrings, the commercial highlights the brand's luxury identity through sophisticated storytelling, atmospheric lighting, and detailed product presentation. Created to build brand awareness and present Sri Lankan gemstone jewellery to a premium audience.

title: NOA AK – Professional Graphic Design Services & Packages
description: A professional promotional video created for NOA AK Creative Digital Agency to showcase its graphic design services and affordable monthly design packages. The video features AI-generated presenter scenes, cinematic transitions, animated typography, premium brand visuals, and creative design showcases. It highlights logo design, social media posts, cover designs, motivational graphics, and customised monthly packages. The advertisement presents the Starter Package at LKR 9,000 and Standard Package at LKR 16,500, along with individual design services. Created to build brand awareness, attract potential clients, and promote NOA AK's creative design solutions.

title: SATLO – Premium Office Meeting Tables | Commercial Advertisement
description: A professional commercial advertisement created for SATLO International (Pvt) Ltd, showcasing its premium office meeting tables and customised furniture solutions. The video features cinematic office environments, elegant wooden tabletop details, modern boardroom setups, and an AI-generated presenter to communicate the product's key features. Highlighting custom-made designs, superior quality finishing, integrated tabletop facilities, and trusted solutions for leading institutions in Sri Lanka, the advertisement presents the brand through engaging visual storytelling and premium product presentation. Designed to strengthen brand awareness and attract corporate customers.

title: Electric Standing Desk – Upgrade Your Workspace
description: A professional AI-powered product advertisement showcasing a modern electric height-adjustable standing desk. The video combines realistic office lifestyle scenes, AI-generated human characters, cinematic product demonstrations, and animated feature highlights to promote a healthier and more flexible workspace. Key features showcased include adjustable desk height from 60cm to 125cm, motorized single/dual motor operation, a maximum load capacity of 120kg, sturdy black and white frames, a 3-year warranty, and over 1,000 customizable tabletop colours. Custom tabletop sizes are available from 60 × 90cm to 210 × 100cm. Created to demonstrate product functionality, highlight customization options, and attract customers looking for premium ergonomic office furniture.

title: NOA AK – AI Video Ads & Creative Digital Solutions
description: A professional AI-powered promotional video created for NOA AK Creative Digital Agency to showcase its creative advertising and digital media services. The video features AI-generated male and female presenters, cinematic visuals, dynamic typography, animated brand elements, and engaging Sinhala promotional content. It highlights the agency's key services, including professional video advertisements, product ads, brand promotions, AI logo animations, and image-to-video animation solutions. Combining AI-generated characters with modern visual storytelling, the project demonstrates how creative technology can help businesses promote their brands and connect with their target audiences. Designed to establish brand identity, communicate creative capabilities, and attract potential business clients.

title: NOA AK – Creative Digital Agency Brand Identity
description:
A modern and premium brand identity design created for NOA AK Creative Digital Agency.

The project features a unique monogram logo combining the letters N and A, representing creativity, innovation, and digital growth.

The visual identity is built around a sophisticated black, gold, and white colour palette, creating a bold, elegant, and professional brand appearance.

The project includes primary and alternative logo concepts, icon variations, monochrome versions, typography selection, colour palette development, and realistic brand application mockups.

Designed to establish a strong and memorable visual identity across digital and print platforms.

Creative Design by NOA AK.

title: VELOXAR MOTORS – Automotive Logo & Brand Identity
description:
A premium automotive brand identity concept designed for VELOXAR MOTORS, inspired by speed, performance, innovation, and luxury.

The project features a sleek and dynamic automotive logo incorporating an abstract vehicle silhouette, representing movement, precision, and modern automotive engineering.

The visual identity combines a sophisticated black, graphite, metallic silver, and deep red colour palette to create a bold and powerful brand presence.

The design presentation includes the primary logo, monochrome variation, compact app icon, and a carefully developed brand colour palette.

Created to reflect the spirit of modern automotive excellence with the brand tagline "DRIVE BEYOND".

Creative Design by NOA AK.
